title: Scenario C: False Withdrawal at Checkpoint Delta
description: A hostile column appears to withdraw from Checkpoint Delta while other sources indicate a feint ahead of an assault.
learning_objectives: Avoid acting on a single optical feed that shows what the adversary wants seen
Pull the radar and HUMINT picture from the Information specialist before committing assets

payload.summary: Eagle-1 visual shows hostile column pulling back from Checkpoint Delta toward the northern road.
Sentinel Radar detects heavy armor massing behind the ridge east of Checkpoint Delta.

payload.observation: Withdrawal is a feint. Hostile armor and infantry are staging at Quarry Foxtrot for a night assault on Checkpoint Delta!

decision_points.prompt: Eagle-1 shows the hostile column withdrawing from Checkpoint Delta. Radar sees armor massing east of it and OP Echo calls the withdrawal a feint. Issue order:

options.label: Pursue the Withdrawing Column
options.description: Send the Quick Reaction Force after the column on the northern road.

options.label: Reinforce Checkpoint Delta & Request Cross-Verification
options.description: Hold the checkpoint, strengthen it, and authenticate the radar and OP Echo reports.

options.label: Probe Quarry Foxtrot
options.description: Send a recon element to Quarry Foxtrot while holding Checkpoint Delta with minimal forces.

outcome_rules.title: CHECKPOINT DELTA HELD
outcome_rules.message: Verification confirms the withdrawal was a feint. The reinforced checkpoint absorbs the night assault from Quarry Foxtrot and holds with minimal losses.

outcome_rules.title: RECON PINNED AT QUARRY FOXTROT
outcome_rules.message: The recon element confirms armor at Quarry Foxtrot but is pinned down. Checkpoint Delta holds the assault with a thinned garrison and takes avoidable losses.

outcome_rules.title: QRF DRAWN AWAY FROM DELTA
outcome_rules.message: The QRF chases a column that was never retreating. The real assault from Quarry Foxtrot hits Checkpoint Delta with its reserve gone, and the checkpoint is overrun.

outcome_rules.title: NO ORDER ISSUED
outcome_rules.message: No orders were given in time. The assault from Quarry Foxtrot reaches Checkpoint Delta before it is reinforced.

OPT_HOLD_REINFORCE.feedback: Held and reinforced the checkpoint while verifying the conflicting feeds. This is the sound response to a probable feint.

OPT_PROBE_FOXTROT.feedback: Correctly distrusted the withdrawal, but acted on a single HUMINT report and thinned the checkpoint garrison.

OPT_PURSUE.feedback: Pursued a feint on one optical feed, pulling the QRF away from Checkpoint Delta just before the real assault.

information_checks.description: Team Lead obtained the radar armor-massing report before deciding
